rodas5p_original_8_stage.equations: Gamma=(I/gamma-C)^(-1); alpha=A*Gamma; beta=alpha+Gamma. The actual stage RHS uses prior stage outputs and prior stage derivative data.
rodas5p_original_8_stage.conclusion: For the represented generic nonlinear 8-stage tableau, same-step exact stage-task parallelism is unavailable without changing the method. Every stage i>1 depends on all earlier stages.
rodas5p_original_8_stage.caveat: Exact rational arithmetic replayed the decimal strings represented in the pinned coefficient snapshot. The temporary replay fixture was reconstructed from GitHub readback and is not claimed byte-identical to the pinned Git blob. This does not certify Rust runtime performance.
formal_graph: stage_1 has no earlier stage predecessor
stage_i depends on all stage_j for 1<=j<i
maximum_antichain_width=1 for the original stage DAG
rodas5p_original_8_stage.exactness_boundary: Exact structural conclusion for the represented generic nonlinear tableau when every lower-triangular coefficient is nonzero. It does not exclude component-wise, linear-algebra, ensemble, spatial or parallel-in-time algorithms, and is not a runtime lower bound.

affine_scan.interpretation: Lower span costs extra composition work and communication. Dense matrix composition can be more expensive than the serial recurrence; report actual work and wall time.
affine_scan.applicability: Only when the stage/update recurrence is genuinely affine or has a validated finite-dimensional associative summary.

work_span.cost_note: Dense affine-map composition can require O(N^3) work per join; structured alternatives may be cheaper. Reduced span does not imply reduced work, memory traffic, communication or wall time.

prohibitions: Do not call a predictor/corrector or stale-stage approximation 'exact parallel RODAS5P'.
Do not infer independence from common-W factorization; common factorization reuses setup but does not make RHS dependencies independent.
Do not count spatial-domain parallelism or IVP ensemble parallelism as temporal stage parallelism.
Do not present a work-depth improvement as a runtime speedup without measuring task scheduling, reductions, memory and communication.
viable_axes: parallel-in-time methods, explicitly treated as different algorithms
